name: KIC 5180026
description: A red giant climbing its first giant branch in the Kepler field, 18.9 solar radii and 1.45 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 5180026 (Gold): Radius (Mosser scale, solar radii) 18.8764 +/- 0.3247

mass.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 5180026 (Gold): Mass (Mosser scale, solar masses) 1.4505 +/- 0.0556

temperature.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 5180026 (Gold): APOGEE effective temperature (K) 4430.3394 +/- 40.2472

gravity.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 5180026 (Gold): Asteroseismic log g 2.0361 +/- 0.0038

color.reason: The star lies in the Galactic plane hundreds to thousands of parsecs away, where interstellar dust reddens its spectra, and the color routes do not remove it; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant in the Kepler field, 19 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations give 1.45 solar masses and 18.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,430 K at its surface.
